info.name: Chariot FDX Accounts Payment Sources API

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the size of the list that is returned. The default (and maximum) is 100 objects.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The cursor to use for pagination. If not set, the first page of results will be returned.

items.docs:
List payment sources for your Chariot account.

Payment Sources represent segregated addresses for incoming deposits.
In practice, this can be separate electronic bank addresses (account + routing numbers) or physical mailing addresses (lockboxes).
Payment Sources make it easy to independently manage and consolidate incoming payments and donations from different sources
which in turn makes reconciliation of money and data seamless.
Every Payment Source belongs to a specific Financial Account and

params.description: The unique identifier for the payment source
